title: Prime-coefficient Artin--Schreier base-change model
statement: Let f:C→Spec(k) be a smooth proper connected curve of dimension at most one [def-sc-curves, def-weil-proper-morphism], with k⊆k' algebraically closed of characteristic p>0, and let C' be its base change. There exist a finite-dimensional k-module V and p-semilinear maps F:V→V and F':k'⊗_k V→k'⊗_k V with F'(1⊗v)=1⊗F(v), and additive equivalences from H¹(C,constant Z/p) [def-sc-constant-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] to V^F and from H¹(C',inverse image of constant Z/p) to (k'⊗V)^{F'}. Under these equivalences the canonical cohomology pullback takes v to 1⊗v. No arbitrary coefficient ring or direct-sum indexing type occurs, and no bijectivity of the fixed-point map is asserted.

source.place: proof: Artin--Schreier kernels, coherent finiteness, and flat base change (02KH)

proof.text: Obtain the compatible coherent Frobenius models, exact rows, degree-zero surjectivity and sheaf-map square from lem-pbc-artin-schreier-frobenius-exact-rows.

For each row, exactness at H^0(G) and surjectivity of H^0(wp) imply that the connecting map to H^1(A) is zero. Exactness at H^1(A) then gives injectivity of H^1(i). Exactness at H^1(G) identifies its image with the kernel of H^1(wp). Transport through b: the equation b(H^1(wp)(x))=F(b(x))-b(x) identifies this kernel with the additive subgroup of fixed points. Explicitly map x to b(H^1(i)(x)); injectivity follows from the two injections, and surjectivity follows by lifting b inverse of each fixed point through H^1(i). AddEquiv.ofBijective packages this map, and its underlying-value formula is retained. Repeat for the primed row. This is the proved private Lean helper exists_fixedPoints_equiv_of_exact_row, using the existing Sheaf.H long-exact-sequence API.

To prove the target pullback equality, apply Subtype.ext and use the underlying-value formulas for the two equivalences. Replace i′ by (upperStar i) followed by q, use Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply, then cohomologyMap_map. The remaining equality is exactly the canonical coherent pullback identity for H^1(i)(x). Return V,F,F′ and the constructed equivalences.
